item.content:encoded:
The Angels announced that the MRI on the injured pitching arm of left-hander Samy Natera Jr. revealed no structural damage and that he will not require surgery.

He’s still looking at a six-week recovery window, but he’ll be able to complete his normal offseason routine without issue and should be ready to go for the start of spring training. He finished the 2025 campaign with a solid 3.13 ERA, 1.11 WHIP and a 48/13 K/BB ratio over 31 2/3 innings out of the Angels’ bullpen.
